---
title: "HG_INF_RNA_RBO_DE_TE"
author: "mfisada"
date: "2026-03-15"
output: html_document
---

Description: Contains all code used for differential expression analysis (DEA)
and translation efficiency analysis (TEA). DEA performed both for time course
data (T0-T180) and for standard pairwise comparison of T200 and T150.

All chunks should be run at least once, after which only chunks marked with
(*) should be required for most analyses.

=== General abbreviations ===
RNA - RNA-seq
RBO - Ribo-seq
DEA - DE analysis
TEA - TE analysis
FUN - Function
p3  - Native Hg plasmid pHGLR3; lost in one RNA/RBO replicate
Np3 - All genetic elements except for pHGLR3
AGE - All genetic elements, including pHGLR3
SCL - Scaled data
CLU - Cluster/clusters
CLU FAM - Cluster family/families
MST - Master data sheets containing compiled data from various analysis steps
VGN - "Vignettes", focusing on specifics like Tafi, translation IFs, etc.

=== DESEQ abbreviations ===
DDS - DESeqDataSet
SFN - sizeFactor-normalized data (DESeq2)
RLD - Rlog-transformed, sizeFactor-normalized data (DESeq2)
WLD - Wald hypothesis test
      T0-T180: WLD used for L2FC calculation/extraction only, not for testing
      T200 vs. T150: WLD used for hypothesis testing
LRT - Likelihood ratio test

```{r}
# === MERGED Hg-HFTV1 ANNOTATION ===

# Load in merged Hg-HFTV1 annotation
Hg_HFTV1_annot_gr <- 
  rtracklayer::import(
    paste(
      "/Users/mi/DIRUGGIERO_LAB/PROJECTS_AND_RESULTS/H_GIBBONSII_HFTV1/",
      "RNA_RBO/c_ANA/b_REANNOTATION/MNL/h_REVISED_ANNOTATIONS/HFTV1_Hg.gff", 
      sep = ""))

# Convert GRanges to data.frame
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df <-  
  as.data.frame(Hg_HFTV1_annot_gr) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = locus_tag) %>%
  relocate(gene_id, .after = "Name")


# === COG / eggNOG ===

# Import COG code
COG_code_df <-
  read_csv(
    "/Users/mi/DIRUGGIERO_LAB/REFERENCES/COG_CODE/cog_code_viral_mods.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE)

# Convert to factors to facilitate graphing much later
COG_code_df$COG_category <-

         levels = COG_code_df$COG_category)
COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl1 <-
  factor(COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl1,
         levels = c(
           "information_storage_and_processing",
           "cellular_processes_and_signaling",
           "metabolism",
           "poorly_characterized",
           "integrated_viral_elements",
           "NAN",
           "no_hits",
           "viral"))
COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long <-
  factor(COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long,
         levels = c(
           "Information storage and processing",
           "Cellular processes and signaling",
           "Metabolism",
           "Poorly characterized",
           "integrated_viral_elements",
           "NAN", 
           "No hits",
           "Viral"))
COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2 <-
  factor(COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2,
         levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2)
COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long <-
  factor(COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long,
         levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long)
  
# Import eggNOG-MAPPER annotations
Hg_COG_df <- 
  read.table(
    paste(
      "/Users/mi/DIRUGGIERO_LAB/REFERENCES/SEQ/H_GIBBONSII/DL_20250521/",
      "GCF_014969745.1/EGGNOG_MAPPER_20250905/annotations.tsv", sep = ""),
  quote = "",
  sep = "\t") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    protein_id = V1, 
    eggNOG_seed_ortholog = V2, 
    eggNOG_evalue = V3, 
    eggNOG_score = V4, 
    eggNOG_OGs = V5, 
    eggNOG_max_annot_lvl = V6, 
    COG_category = V7, 
    Description = V8, 
    eggNOG_gene_name = V9, 
    eggNOG_GOs = V10, 
    eggNOG_EC = V11, 
    KEGG_ko = V12,
    KEGG_Pathway = V13, 
    KEGG_Module = V14, 
    KEGG_Reaction = V15,
    KEGG_rclass = V16, 
    BRITE = V17, 
    KEGG_TC = V18, 
    CAZy = V19,
    BIGG_Reaction = V20, 
    PFAMs = V21) %>%
  select(c(protein_id, COG_category, Description, eggNOG_gene_name))

# Reformat Hg COG df for compatability with custom HFTV1 COG df
Hg_COG_df <-
  left_join(
    Hg_COG_df,
    Hg_HFTV1_annot_df %>% 
      select(c("gene_id", "protein_id")),
    by = "protein_id") %>% 
  select(!protein_id) %>%
  relocate(gene_id, .before = COG_category)

# Import HFTV1 COG df
HFTV1_COG_df <- 
  read_csv(
    paste(
      "/Users/mi/DIRUGGIERO_LAB/REFERENCES/SEQ/HFTV1/DL_20240430/",
      "GCF_004208775.1/ANNOT_FUNCTION_REVISION/CUSTOM_COGS_20260722/",
      "HFTV1_COGs.csv", sep = ""),
    show_col_types = FALSE)

# Combine Hg and HFTV1 COG information
Hg_HFTV1_COG_df <-
  rbind(Hg_COG_df, HFTV1_COG_df)

# Combine COG information with decoded COG information
Hg_HFTV1_COG_df <- 
  left_join(
    Hg_HFTV1_COG_df,
    COG_code_df,
    by = "COG_category")

# === COMBINING ANNOTATIONS ===

# Combine COG annotations with NCBI-P/P-RPR annotations
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df <-
  merge(
    Hg_HFTV1_annot_df, 
    Hg_HFTV1_COG_df, 
    by="gene_id", all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert NAs to string so that they can be manipulated more easily in
    # graphs later. 
    COG_category = replace_na(COG_category, "-"),
    COG_desc_lvl1 = replace_na(COG_desc_lvl1, "no_hits"),
    COG_desc_lvl1_long = replace_na(COG_desc_lvl1_long, "No hits"),
    COG_desc_lvl2 = replace_na(COG_desc_lvl2, "no_hits"),
    COG_desc_lvl2_long = replace_na(COG_desc_lvl2_long, "No hits"),
    
    # Manually reassign COG categories for genes with more than one
    # COG category.
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "GT", "G"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "EGP", "E"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "PT", "P"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "NU", "N"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "NT", "N"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "BQ", "B"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "JM", "J"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "CP", "C"),
    COG_category = replace(COG_category, COG_category == "GH", "G"))

# Add entity column to easily distinguish between host and virus
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df <-
  Hg_HFTV1_annot_df %>%
  mutate(
    entity = 
      case_when(str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg")) 

# Convert some COG columns to factors for graphing much further downstream
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_category <-
  factor(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_category,
         levels = COG_code_df$COG_category)
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl1 <-
  factor(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl1,
         levels = c(
           "information_storage_and_processing",
           "cellular_processes_and_signaling",
           "metabolism",
           "poorly_characterized",
           "integrated_viral_elements",
           "NAN",
           "no_hits",
           "viral"))
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long <-
  factor(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long,
         levels = c(
           "Information storage and processing",
           "Cellular processes and signaling",
           "Metabolism",
           "Poorly characterized",
           "integrated_viral_elements",
           "NAN", 
           "No hits",
           "Viral"))
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl2 <-
  factor(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl2,
         levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2)
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long <-
  factor(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long,
         levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long)


# Subset to most useful columns
Hg_HFTV1_annot_df <-

  select(c(
    entity,
    seqnames,
    gene_id,
    protein_id,
    start,
    end,
    width,
    strand,
    type,
    source,
    product,
    COG_category,
    COG_desc_lvl1,
    COG_desc_lvl1_long,
    COG_desc_lvl2,
    COG_desc_lvl2_long,
    eggNOG_gene_name,
    Description))


# === SUBSETS ===

# Create lists of all genes and of entity-specific genes
Hg_HFTV1_annot_genes <- unique(Hg_HFTV1_annot_df[ ,"gene_id"])
HFTV1_annot_genes <- Hg_HFTV1_annot_genes[grep("M1M17", (Hg_HFTV1_annot_genes))]
Hg_annot_genes <- Hg_HFTV1_annot_genes[grep("HfgLR", (Hg_HFTV1_annot_genes))]

# Subset to all CDSs
Hg_HFTV1_annot_CDS_df <- 
  Hg_HFTV1_annot_df %>%
  filter(type == "CDS")

# Subset to all non-p3 CDSs
Hg_HFTV1_annot_Np3_CDS_df <-

Hg_annot_p3_CDS_df <-

write_csv(

  paste(

write_csv(
```

# === COG FACTOR CONVERSION FUN (*) ==========================================
```{r}
COG_factor_conversion_fun <-
  function(
    input_df,
    COG_code = COG_code_df) {
    
    input_df$COG_category <-
      factor(
        input_df$COG_category,
        levels = COG_code$COG_category)
    
    input_df$COG_desc_lvl1 <-
      factor(
        input_df$COG_desc_lvl1,
        levels = c(
          "information_storage_and_processing",
           "cellular_processes_and_signaling",
           "metabolism",
           "poorly_characterized",
           "integrated_viral_elements",
           "NAN",
           "no_hits",
           "viral"))
    
    input_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long <-
      factor(
        input_df$COG_desc_lvl1_long,
        levels = c(
          "Information storage and processing",
           "Cellular processes and signaling",
           "Metabolism",
           "Integrated viral elements",
           "Poorly characterized",
           "NAN", 
           "No hits",
           "Viral"))
    
    input_df$COG_desc_lvl2 <-
      factor(
        input_df$COG_desc_lvl2,
        levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2)
    
    input_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long <-
      factor(
        input_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long,
        levels = COG_code_df$COG_desc_lvl2_long)
    
    return(input_df)
    
  }


```

# === DEA | INPUTS ==========================================================
```{r}
# Prepare data and metadata for DE analysis
# Some code is derived from SRC

# === RNA ===

RNA_fc_fn <- function(rep, sample) {
  
  dataframe <- 
    # Read in featurecounts data
    read_tsv(paste("../b_REP/", rep,
                   "_RNA/d_SEQ_ANALYSIS/i_FEATURECOUNTS/", sample,
                   "_fc.txt", sep=""),
             # Skip first line (record of featurecounts command)
             skip=1, 
             # Do not show column type
             show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    # Rename columns 
    dplyr::rename(
      # Column 1: gene ID
      gene_id = 1,
      # Column 7: sample-specific feature counts
      {{sample}}:=7) %>%
    # Select only the gene_id and read counts columns for further use. 
    dplyr::select(c(1,7)) %>% 
    # Round read count values to nearest integer (for featurecount data
    # generated using --fraction option for reads that map to overlapping
    # features. 
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 0)) %>%
    # Subset to unique entries
    unique()
  
  return(dataframe)
  
}

# BR2
BR2_RNA_000_E_fc_df <- RNA_fc_fn("BR2", "BR2_RNA_000_E")
BR2_RNA_005_E_fc_df <- RNA_fc_fn("BR2", "BR2_RNA_005_E")
BR2_RNA_015_E_fc_df <- RNA_fc_fn("BR2", "BR2_RNA_015_E")

BR4_RNA_180_E_fc_df <- RNA_fc_fn("BR4", "BR4_RNA_180_E")

# Extract read counts, combine, and reformat

  full_join(BR2_RNA_005_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR2_RNA_015_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR2_RNA_030_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%

  # BR3
  full_join(BR3_RNA_000_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR3_RNA_005_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR3_RNA_015_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR3_RNA_030_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR3_RNA_060_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR3_RNA_180_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%

  full_join(BR4_RNA_005_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR4_RNA_015_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  full_join(BR4_RNA_030_E_fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%

# Subset featurecounts data to non-p3 genes
RNA_fc_Np3_df <-
  RNA_fc_df %>%
  filter(rownames(RNA_fc_df) %in% Hg_HFTV1_annot_Np3_CDS_df$gene_id)

# Subset featurecounts data to p3 genes.
RNA_fc_p3_df <-
  RNA_fc_df %>%
  filter(rownames(RNA_fc_df) %in% Hg_annot_p3_CDS_df$gene_id) %>%
  # Remove biological replicate that was missing p3.
  select(!contains("BR2"))


# Create non-p3 metadata
RNA_Np3_meta_df <- 
  data.frame(
    col = colnames(RNA_fc_Np3_df),
    # Time
    time = 
      
      factor(
        
        rep(
          c("000_PI","005_PI","015_PI","030_PI","060_PI","180_PI"), times = 3),
        
        levels = c("000_PI","005_PI","015_PI","030_PI","060_PI","180_PI")),
    
    # Biological replicate
    biorep = 
      factor(c("BR2", "BR2", "BR2", "BR2", "BR2", "BR2", 
               "BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3",
               "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4"),
             levels = c("BR2", "BR3", "BR4")),
    
    # Batch (effectively the same as biorep)
    batch = 
      factor(c("batch1", "batch1", "batch1", "batch1", "batch1", "batch1", 
               "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", 
               "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3"),
             levels = c("batch1", "batch2", "batch3")),
    
    # Experimental/infected ("E") vs. control/mock-infected (C); for now, all
    # samples are experimental only.
    infection = 
      factor(rep(c("E"), times = 18)),
    # Sample type (RNA vs RBO)
    sample_type = 
      factor(rep(c("RNA"), times = 18))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("col")

# Create p3 metadata
RNA_p3_meta_df <- 
  data.frame(
    col = colnames(RNA_fc_p3_df),
    # Time (nominal)
    # https://www.biostars.org/p/9499264/
    time = 
      
      factor(
        
        rep(
          c("000_PI","005_PI","015_PI","030_PI","060_PI","180_PI"), times = 2),
        
        levels = c("000_PI","005_PI","015_PI","030_PI","060_PI","180_PI")),
    
    # Biological replicate
    biorep = 
      factor(c("BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3", "BR3",
               "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4", "BR4"),
             levels = c("BR2", "BR3", "BR4")),
    
    # Batch (effectively the same as biorep)
    batch = 
      factor(c("batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", "batch2", 
               "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3", "batch3"),
             levels = c("batch2", "batch3")),
    
    # Experimental/infected ("E") vs. control/mock-infected (C); for now, all
    # samples are experimental only.
    infection = 
      factor(rep(c("E"), times = 12)),
    # Sample type (RNA vs RBO)
    sample_type = 
      factor(rep(c("RNA"), times = 12))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("col")

# === RBO ===

                   "_RBO/e_SEQ_ANALYSIS/m_FEATURECOUNTS/", sample,
                   "_fc.txt", sep=""),
             # Skip first line (record of featurecounts command)

    # Rename columns

      # Column 1: gene ID
      gene_id = 1,
      # Column 7: sample-specific feature counts
      {{sample}}:=7) %>%
    # Select only the gene_id and read counts columns for further use. 
    dplyr::select(c(1,7)) %>% 
    # Round read count values to nearest integer (for featurecount data
    # generated using --fraction option for reads that map to overlapping
    # features. 
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 0)) %>%
    # Subset to unique entries
    unique()
  
  return(dataframe)
  
}
```

# === DEA | DDS =============================================================
```{r}
dds_generate_filter_fn <- function(count_data, col_data) {
  
  # Construct DESeqDataSet (DDS)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = count_data,
    colData = col_data,
    design = ~ batch + time)
  
  # Define values for pre-filtering. 
  
  # smallestCountSize: Minimum number of counts per gene
  smallestCountSize <- 50
  # smallestGroupSize: Minimum number of groups in which gene is expressed.
  # If there are not discrete groups, use the minimal number of samples where
  # non-zero counts would be considered interesting. 
  smallestGroupSize <- 2
  
  # Filter DDS
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= smallestCountSize) >=
    smallestGroupSize
  dds_filter <- dds[keep,]
  
  return(dds_filter)
}

# === RNA ===

RNA_Np3_dds <- 
  dds_generate_filter_fn(RNA_fc_Np3_df, RNA_Np3_meta_df)
RNA_Np3_dds_vals <- assay(RNA_Np3_dds)
RNA_p3_dds <-
  dds_generate_filter_fn(RNA_fc_p3_df, RNA_p3_meta_df)
RNA_p3_dds_vals <- assay(RNA_p3_dds)

# === RBO ===
RBO_Np3_dds <- 
  dds_generate_filter_fn(RBO_fc_Np3_df, RBO_Np3_meta_df)
RBO_Np3_dds_vals <- assay(RBO_Np3_dds)
RBO_p3_dds <-
  dds_generate_filter_fn(RBO_fc_p3_df, RBO_p3_meta_df)
```

# === DEA | SFN | SUMMARY | FUN =============================================
```{r}
transf_summary_fn <- 
  function(transf_df) {
    
    
    # === PRELIMINARIES ===
    
    # Based on input dataframe name, construct vector of "arguments" that
    # describe some features of the input dataframe. Assumes transf_df name
    # structure of <sample_type>_<genetic_elements>_<transf_type>_...
    df_args <- str_split(deparse(substitute(transf_df)), "_", simplify = TRUE)
    
    # Sample type (RNA vs. RBO)
    sample_type <- df_args[1]
    
    # Genetic elements (Np3 vs p3)
    genetic_elements <- df_args[2]
    
    # Transformation type (rlog [rld], variance-stabilized[vsd], size-factor-
    # normalized [sfnorm], etc.)
    transf_type <- df_args[3]
    
    transf_df <-
      transf_df %>%
      # Convert gene IDs to rownames so that they are preserved even after
      # selection of specific columns during various subsetting steps below. 
      column_to_rownames("gene_id")
    
    # Account for missing samples (no missing samples in RNA, but two
    # missing across all RBO replicates).
    col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 180)
    if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      BR2_col_names <- col_names
      BR3_col_names <- col_names
      BR4_col_names <- col_names
    } else if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      # Account for missing data for pHGLR3
      if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
        # Redefine column names to rename subset columns for graphing later
        # (no 60 min sample in RBO data; there was only one replicate after
        # BR2 was removed, so I took it out entirely).
        RBO_p3_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 180)
        BR3_col_names <- RBO_p3_col_names
        BR4_col_names <- RBO_p3_col_names
      } else if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
        BR2_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 60, 180)
        BR3_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 180)
        BR4_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 180)
      }
    }
    
    
    # === SUBSET TRANSFORMED EXPRESSION VALUES BY BIOLOGICAL REPLICATE ===

    # These or mean values can be used for DP-GP-Cluster.

    BR2_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR2")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    # Only try to rename BR2 column names for non-p3 genetic elements. BR2
    # data for p3 do not exist.
    if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      colnames(BR2_transf_df) <- BR2_col_names
    }
    BR3_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR3")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    colnames(BR3_transf_df) <- BR3_col_names
    BR4_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR4")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    colnames(BR4_transf_df) <- BR4_col_names


    # === CALCULATE SUMMARY STATISTICS ===

    # Calculate mean expression value for each row (gene) and at each time
    # point ("000", "005", "015",...) across biological replicates.
    transf_000_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>%
      # Select columns for specific time point / condition.
      select(contains("000_E")) %>%
      mutate(
        # Calculate row-wise mean across all selected columns.
        mean_000_E = rowMeans(.),
        # Calculate row-wise standard deviation across all selected columns.
        stdev_000_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    # Do the same as above for all other time points / conditions.
    transf_005_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("005_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_005_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_005_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    transf_015_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("015_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_015_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_015_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    transf_030_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("030_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_030_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_030_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    # Conditionally calculate summary stats for 060 TP to exclude RBO p3
    if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      transf_060_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("060_E")) %>%
        mutate(mean_060_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_060_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    } else if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
      if (sample_type == "RNA") {
        transf_060_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("060_E")) %>%
          mutate(mean_060_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_060_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
      }
    }
    transf_180_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("180_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_180_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_180_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))

    # Combine all mean values into a single dataframe
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_000_E_summary_df, transf_005_E_summary_df,
            by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_015_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_030_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    # Include 060 time point for RNA regardless of genetic elements
    if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      transf_summary_df <-
        merge(transf_060_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
        column_to_rownames("Row.names")
      # Include 060 time point for RBO only if dealing with non-p3 genetic
      # elements.
    } else if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      transf_summary_df <-
        merge(transf_060_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
        column_to_rownames("Row.names")
      }
    }
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_180_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")


    # === REFORMAT AND SUBSET DATA ===

    transf_summary_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      # Order columns alphabetically
      select(order(colnames(transf_summary_df))) %>%
      # Convert row names to column
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")

    # Subset to means and gene IDs only
    transf_means_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      select(contains(c("gene_id", "mean")))

    # Subset to stdev and gene IDs only
    transf_stdev_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      select(contains(c("gene_id", "stdev")))

    # Rename column names for graphing, adjusting accordingly for RBO p3
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
        colnames(transf_means_df) <- RBO_p3_col_names
        colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- RBO_p3_col_names
      } else if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
        colnames(transf_means_df) <- col_names
        colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- col_names
      }
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      colnames(transf_means_df) <- col_names
      colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- col_names
    }


    # === SCALE MEAN VALUES ===

    # Scaled data can be used in R to visualize DP-GP-clusted genes.
    # Convert gene IDs to row names so they are not affected during
    # transposition and scaling.
    transf_means_to_transpose_df <-
      transf_means_df %>%
      column_to_rownames("gene_id")
    # Transpose data for scaling
    transf_means_t_df <- as.data.frame(t(transf_means_to_transpose_df))
    # Scale data (for each gene, mean-center and then divide by stdev)
    transf_means_t_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(scale(transf_means_t_df))
    # Transpose scaled data again to return it to the original shape.
    transf_means_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(t(transf_means_t_scaled_df))
    # Convert gene IDs back to column for downstream applications.
    transf_means_scaled_df <-
      transf_means_scaled_df %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")


    # === EXPORTS ===

    # Individual biological replicates
    write_csv(
      BR2_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR2_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))
    write_csv(
      BR3_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR3_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))
    write_csv(
      BR4_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR4_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))

    # Summary statistics
    write_csv(
      transf_summary_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_summary.csv", sep = ""))
    # Means only
    write_csv(
      transf_means_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_means.csv", sep = ""))
    # Stdev only
    write_csv(
      transf_stdev_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_stdev.csv", sep = ""))
    # Scaled means only
    write_csv(
      transf_means_scaled_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/c_SFN/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_means_scaled.csv", sep = ""))


    # === FUNCTION OUTPUT ===

    fn_output <-
      list("transf_summary_df" = transf_summary_df,
           "transf_means_df" = transf_means_df,
           "transf_stdev_df" = transf_stdev_df,
           "transf_means_scaled_df" = transf_means_scaled_df)

    return(fn_output)
}

```

# === DEA | RLD | SUMMARY | FUN =============================================
```{r}
transf_summary_fn <- 
  function(transf_df) {
    
    
    # === PRELIMINARIES ===
    
    # Based on input dataframe name, construct vector of "arguments" that
    # describe some features of the input dataframe. Assumes transf_df name
    # structure of <sample_type>_<genetic_elements>_<transf_type>_...
    df_args <- str_split(deparse(substitute(transf_df)), "_", simplify = TRUE)
    
    # Sample type (RNA vs. RBO)
    sample_type <- df_args[1]
    
    # Genetic elements (Np3 vs p3)
    genetic_elements <- df_args[2]
    
    # Transformation type (rlog [rld], variance-stabilized[vsd], size-factor-
    # normalized [sfnorm], etc.)
    transf_type <- df_args[3]
    
    transf_df <-
      transf_df %>%
      # Convert gene IDs to rownames so that they are preserved even after
      # selection of specific columns during various subsetting steps below. 
      column_to_rownames("gene_id")
    
    # Account for missing samples (no missing samples in RNA, but two
    # missing across all RBO replicates).
    col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 180)
    if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      BR2_col_names <- col_names
      BR3_col_names <- col_names
      BR4_col_names <- col_names
    } else if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      # Account for missing data for pHGLR3
      if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
        # Redefine column names to rename subset columns for graphing later
        # (no 60 min sample in RBO data; there was only one replicate after
        # BR2 was removed, so I took it out entirely).
        RBO_p3_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 180)
        BR3_col_names <- RBO_p3_col_names
        BR4_col_names <- RBO_p3_col_names
      } else if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
        BR2_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 60, 180)
        BR3_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 180)
        BR4_col_names <- c("gene_id", 0, 5, 15, 30, 60, 180)
      }
    }
    
    
    # === SUBSET TRANSFORMED EXPRESSION VALUES BY BIOLOGICAL REPLICATE ===

    # These or mean values can be used for DP-GP-Cluster.

    BR2_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR2")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    # Only try to rename BR2 column names for non-p3 genetic elements. BR2
    # data for p3 do not exist.
    if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      colnames(BR2_transf_df) <- BR2_col_names
    }
    BR3_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR3")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    colnames(BR3_transf_df) <- BR3_col_names
    BR4_transf_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("BR4")) %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")
    colnames(BR4_transf_df) <- BR4_col_names


    # === CALCULATE SUMMARY STATISTICS ===

    # Calculate mean expression value for each row (gene) and at each time
    # point ("000", "005", "015",...) across biological replicates.
    transf_000_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>%
      # Select columns for specific time point / condition.
      select(contains("000_E")) %>%
      mutate(
        # Calculate row-wise mean across all selected columns.
        mean_000_E = rowMeans(.),
        # Calculate row-wise standard deviation across all selected columns.
        stdev_000_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    # Do the same as above for all other time points / conditions.
    transf_005_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("005_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_005_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_005_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    transf_015_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("015_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_015_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_015_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    transf_030_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("030_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_030_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_030_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    # Conditionally calculate summary stats for 060 TP to exclude RBO p3
    if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      transf_060_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("060_E")) %>%
        mutate(mean_060_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_060_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
    } else if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
      if (sample_type == "RNA") {
        transf_060_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("060_E")) %>%
          mutate(mean_060_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_060_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))
      }
    }
    transf_180_E_summary_df <- transf_df %>% select(contains("180_E")) %>%
      mutate(mean_180_E = rowMeans(.), stdev_180_E = rowSds(as.matrix(.)))

    # Combine all mean values into a single dataframe
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_000_E_summary_df, transf_005_E_summary_df,
            by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_015_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_030_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")
    # Include 060 time point for RNA regardless of genetic elements
    if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      transf_summary_df <-
        merge(transf_060_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
        column_to_rownames("Row.names")
      # Include 060 time point for RBO only if dealing with non-p3 genetic
      # elements.
    } else if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
      transf_summary_df <-
        merge(transf_060_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
        column_to_rownames("Row.names")
      }
    }
    transf_summary_df <-
      merge(transf_180_E_summary_df, transf_summary_df, by = "row.names") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Row.names")


    # === REFORMAT AND SUBSET DATA ===

    transf_summary_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      # Order columns alphabetically
      select(order(colnames(transf_summary_df))) %>%
      # Convert row names to column
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")

    # Subset to means and gene IDs only
    transf_means_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      select(contains(c("gene_id", "mean")))

    # Subset to stdev and gene IDs only
    transf_stdev_df <-
      transf_summary_df %>%
      select(contains(c("gene_id", "stdev")))

    # Rename column names for graphing, adjusting accordingly for RBO p3
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      if (genetic_elements == "p3") {
        colnames(transf_means_df) <- RBO_p3_col_names
        colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- RBO_p3_col_names
      } else if (genetic_elements == "Np3") {
        colnames(transf_means_df) <- col_names
        colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- col_names
      }
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      colnames(transf_means_df) <- col_names
      colnames(transf_stdev_df) <- col_names
    }


    # === SCALE MEAN VALUES ===

    # Scaled data can be used in R to visualize DP-GP-clusted genes.
    # Convert gene IDs to row names so they are not affected during
    # transposition and scaling.
    transf_means_to_transpose_df <-
      transf_means_df %>%
      column_to_rownames("gene_id")
    # Transpose data for scaling
    transf_means_t_df <- as.data.frame(t(transf_means_to_transpose_df))
    # Scale data (for each gene, mean-center and then divide by stdev)
    transf_means_t_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(scale(transf_means_t_df))
    # Transpose scaled data again to return it to the original shape.
    transf_means_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(t(transf_means_t_scaled_df))
    # Convert gene IDs back to column for downstream applications.
    transf_means_scaled_df <-
      transf_means_scaled_df %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene_id")


    # === EXPORTS ===

    # Individual biological replicates
    write_csv(
      BR2_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR2_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))
    write_csv(
      BR3_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR3_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))
    write_csv(
      BR4_transf_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/a_DATA/",
            sample_type, "_BR4_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, ".csv", sep = ""))

    # Summary statistics
    write_csv(
      transf_summary_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_summary.csv", sep = ""))
    # Means only
    write_csv(
      transf_means_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_means.csv", sep = ""))
    # Stdev only
    write_csv(
      transf_stdev_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_stdev.csv", sep = ""))
    # Scaled means only
    write_csv(
      transf_means_scaled_df,
      paste("../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/d_RLD/b_SUMMARY/",
            sample_type, "_", genetic_elements, "_",
            transf_type, "_means_scaled.csv", sep = ""))


    # === FUNCTION OUTPUT ===

    fn_output <-
      list("transf_summary_df" = transf_summary_df,
           "transf_means_df" = transf_means_df,
           "transf_stdev_df" = transf_stdev_df,
           "transf_means_scaled_df" = transf_means_scaled_df)

    return(fn_output)
}

```

```{r}
RBO_rld_means_HFTV1_df <-

    by = "gene_id") %>%
  arrange(start )%>%

  # remove tRNA
  filter(gene_id != "M1M17_tRNA01")
# Create version of data with gene IDs as row names

# Quantile breaks function to improve visual distinction between
# early and late genes (https://slowkow.com/notes/pheatmap-tutorial/).
quantile_breaks <- function(xs, n = 10) {
  breaks <- quantile(xs, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n))
  breaks[!duplicated(breaks)]
}



# === GRAPH ===
```

# === DEA | VAR | PCA =======================================================
```{r}

# RNA Np3

RNA_Np3_rld_pca_data <- 
  plotPCA(
    RNA_Np3_rld, 
    intgroup = c("time", "batch"),
    returnData = TRUE)

RNA_Np3_rld_pca_data <- 
  RNA_Np3_rld_pca_data %>%
  mutate(
    br_condition = case_when(
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR2", name) ~ "BR2_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR3", name) ~ "BR3_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR4", name) ~ "BR4_E"))

RNA_Np3_rld_pca_percentVar <- 
  round(100 * attr(RNA_Np3_rld_pca_data, "percentVar"))

RNA_Np3_rld_pca_plot <- 
  
  ggplot(RNA_Np3_rld_pca_data, 
         aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
             color = time, fill = time, shape = br_condition)) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 4, stroke = 1, color = "black") +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("BR2_E" = 23,
               "BR3_E" = 21,
               "BR4_E" = 22),
    labels = c("BR2_E" = "BR2 +HFTV1",
               "BR3_E" = "BR3 +HFTV1",
               "BR4_E" = "BR4 +HFTV1"),
    name = "rep_condition") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "000_PI" = "#fee5d9", 
      "005_PI" = "#fcbba1",
      "015_PI" = "#fc9272", 
      "030_PI" = "#fb6a4a", 
      "060_PI" = "#de2d26", 
      "180_PI" = "#a50f15"),
    labels = c(
      "0 min", 
      "5 min", 
      "15 min", 
      "30 min", 
      "60 min", 
      "180 min"),
    
    name = "Time PI") +
  
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      "Time PI", override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(
      "Rep & condition", override.aes = list(fill = "black"))) +
  guides(
    color = FALSE) +
  
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", RNA_Np3_rld_pca_percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", RNA_Np3_rld_pca_percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  ylim(-40, 60) +
  xlim(-50, 50) +
  ggtitle("RNA-Seq PCA (RLD)") +
  theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),
        
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75)
        )

ggsave(
  "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/e_VAR/RNA_Np3_rld_pca_plot.png",
  plot = RNA_Np3_rld_pca_plot,
  width = 10, height = 10,
  units = "cm", dpi = 300)

ggsave(
  "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/e_VAR/RNA_Np3_rld_pca_plot.svg",
  plot = RNA_Np3_rld_pca_plot,
  width = 10, height = 10,
  units = "cm", dpi = 300)




# RBO Np3

RBO_Np3_rld_pca_data <- 
  plotPCA(
    RBO_Np3_rld, 
    intgroup = c("time", "batch"),
    returnData = TRUE)

RBO_Np3_rld_pca_data <- 
  RBO_Np3_rld_pca_data %>%
  mutate(
    br_condition = case_when(
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR2", name) ~ "BR2_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR3", name) ~ "BR3_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR4", name) ~ "BR4_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR5", name) ~ "BR5_E",
      grepl("E", name) & grepl("BR6", name) ~ "BR6_E"))

RBO_Np3_rld_pca_percentVar <- 
  round(100 * attr(RBO_Np3_rld_pca_data, "percentVar"))

RBO_Np3_rld_pca_plot <- 
  
  ggplot(
    RBO_Np3_rld_pca_data, 
    aes(
      x = PC1, y = PC2,
      fill = time, 
      shape = br_condition)) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 4, stroke = 1, color = "black") +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("BR2_E" = 23,
               "BR3_E" = 21,
               "BR4_E" = 22,
               "BR5_E" = 24,
               "BR6_E" = 25),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),
        
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75)
        )
```

```{r}
# THESE TESTS ARE NOT TO ASSESS DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION!!!!! They are only
# a convenient way to produce and extract L2FC values.

# Pairwise comparisons, Wald test (DESeq2 default test)
RNA_Np3_wald <- DESeq(RNA_Np3_dds)
RNA_p3_wald <- DESeq(RNA_p3_dds)

RBO_Np3_wald <- DESeq(RBO_Np3_dds)
RBO_p3_wald <- DESeq(RBO_p3_dds)

# === RNA WALD CONTRASTS ===
RNA_Np3_wald_res_005E_vs_000E <-
  results(RNA_Np3_wald, contrast = c("time", "005_PI", "000_PI"))
RNA_Np3_wald_res_015E_vs_000E <-
  results(RNA_Np3_wald, contrast = c("time", "015_PI", "000_PI"))

  results(RNA_Np3_wald, contrast = c("time", "030_PI", "000_PI"))

  results(RNA_Np3_wald, contrast = c("time", "060_PI", "000_PI"))

  results(RNA_Np3_wald, contrast = c("time", "180_PI", "000_PI"))
```

```{r}
# Need to account for total number of tests performed across all genetic
# elements. 

# https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/stats/html/p.adjust.html
# https://master.bioconductor.org/packages/release/workflows/vignettes/rnaseqGene/inst/doc/rnaseqGene.html#ref-Anders2010Differential

# BH-adjusted p-values: e.g., value of 0.1 -> 10% false positives due to 
# multiple testing. 

RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df$padj_bh <-
  p.adjust(
    RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df$pvalue,
    method = "BH",
    n = nrow(RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df))

    method = "BH",
```

# === DEA | LRT | RESULTS | SIGNIF FILTER ===================================
```{r}
# Function
LRT_padj_filter_fn <- 
  function(res_df, padj_threshold_name, padj_threshold_val) {
  # Filter DESeq2 LRT results based on adjusted p-value. Note: L2FC is NOT a
  # relevant metric for filtering LRT results; see DESeq2 documentation. 
  padj_filtered_df <- 
    res_df %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(padj_bh < padj_threshold_val) 
  # Save filtered dataframe
  res_name <- deparse(substitute(res_df))
  padj_filtered_df %>%
    write_csv(paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/g_LRT/c_SIGNIF_FILTER/a_DATA/",
      res_name, "_",
      padj_threshold_name, ".csv", sep=""))
  # Create objects corresponding to number of Hg and HFVT1 DE genes. 
  Hg_gene_ct <- 
    nrow(padj_filtered_df[grep("HfgLR", padj_filtered_df$gene_id), ])
  HFTV1_gene_ct <- 
    nrow(padj_filtered_df[grep("M1M17", padj_filtered_df$gene_id), ])
  # Store filtered dataframe and gene counts in a list and then return that
  # list from the function; these objects can then be retrieved individually
  # outside the function. 
  fn_list <- list(
    "padj_filtered_df" = padj_filtered_df,
    "Hg_gene_ct" = Hg_gene_ct, 
    "HFTV1_gene_ct" = HFTV1_gene_ct)
  return(fn_list)
  
}

# === RNA ===

  LRT_padj_filter_fn(RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df, "10e-4", 0.0001)
```

# === DEA | LRT | DEG/NDEG | IMPORT AND NDEG SUBSET =========================
```{r}

# ===========
# === DEG ===
# ===========

# Import 
# Selected significance threshold: FDR-corrected pval < 10e-5

RNA_AGE_DEG <- 
  read_csv(
    paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/g_LRT/c_SIGNIF_FILTER/a_DATA/",
      "RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df_10e-5.csv", sep = ""),
    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(RNA_DE = "DEG")

RBO_AGE_DEG <- 
  read_csv(
    paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/g_LRT/c_SIGNIF_FILTER/a_DATA/",
      "RBO_AGE_lrt_res_df_10e-5.csv", sep = ""),
    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(RBO_DE = "DEG")

# ============
# === NDEG ===
# ============

# Identify genes that are or not DE (nDEGs) based on the DEGs that
# were imported. This division is based on all the genes that were initially
# tested for DE by LRT; note that this is different from using all genes
# in Hg-HFTV1 annotation, since the genes tested for DE must first pass
# thresholds for minimum read counts and minimum number of occurrences across
# samples. I think this is the best approach since our reference point should
# be all reasonably well-expressed genes, not just every single gene predicted
# based on DNA sequence. 

RNA_AGE_NDEG <-
  anti_join(
    # All genes
    RNA_AGE_lrt_res_df,
    # DEGs
    RNA_AGE_DEG,
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(RNA_DE = "NDEG")

RBO_AGE_NDEG <-
  anti_join(
    # All genes
    RBO_AGE_lrt_res_df,
    # DEGs
    RBO_AGE_DEG,
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(RBO_DE = "NDEG")

```

```{r}
    gene_id = gene)

  read.table(
    paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/b_OUTPUT/",
      "RNA_p3_DEG_optimal_clustering.txt",
      sep = ""),
    sep = "\t", header = T) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    clu = cluster,
    gene_id = gene)
# p3 ID edit
RNA_p3_clu_edit_df <-
  RNA_p3_clu_df %>%
  # Change cluster IDs for pHGLR3 so that they can be distinguished from
  # non-pHGLR3 clusters when grouped into families later.
  mutate(
    clu =
      case_when(
        clu == 1 ~ 41,
        clu == 2 ~ 42,
        clu == 3 ~ 43,
        # Default ID of 999 added to any other clusters that appear. If
        # 999 is detected as ID in some output, then something is wrong;
        # inspect more closely.
        TRUE ~ NA))

# Combine AGE
RNA_AGE_clu_df <-
  rbind(
    RNA_Np3_clu_df,
    RNA_p3_clu_edit_df)
```

# === DEA | CLU | VIS | FUN | RBO ===========================================
```{r}
RBO_clu_vis_fun <-
  
  function(
    sample_type,
    AGE_clu_df,
    AGE_rld_means_scl_df,
    AGE_l2fc_df) {
    
    # Convert clusters to factors for graphing to retain cluster hierarchy. 
    AGE_clu_df <- 
      AGE_clu_df %>%
      select(c(clu, gene_id)) %>%
      arrange(clu)
    AGE_clu_df$clu <-
      factor(AGE_clu_df$clu, levels = unique(AGE_clu_df$clu))
    
    # Add entity-specifying column for coloring in graphs.
    AGE_clu_df <-
      AGE_clu_df %>% 
      mutate(
        entity = 
          case_when(
            str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg"))
    
    # Tally number of Hg and HFTV1 genes per cluster for graph annotations
    AGE_clu_df <-
      AGE_clu_df %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(
        clu_gene_ct_Hg = sum(startsWith(gene_id, "HfgLR")),
        clu_gene_ct_HFTV1 = sum(startsWith(gene_id, "M1M17")),
        clu_gene_ct_total = clu_gene_ct_Hg + clu_gene_ct_HFTV1) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Combine clusters with RLD means scaled.
    clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_df, AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c("0", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "rld_means_scl")
    clu_means_scl_l_df$time_PI <- 
      as.numeric(clu_means_scl_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Combine clusters with L2FC data
    clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_df, AGE_l2fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c( "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "L2FC")
    clu_l2fc_l_df$time_PI <- as.numeric(clu_l2fc_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Subset for genetic elements
    
    Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    Np3_clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    
    p3_clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    p3_clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    
    # Graph annotation setup for scaled data
    
    # Determine max (rounded up) and min (rounded down) values for expression
    # data. Base on Np3 data since p3 has NAs from 60 min time point absence.
    # means_max_ceiling <- max(ceiling(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$rld_means_scl))
    # means_min_floor <- min(floor(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$rld_means_scl))
    
    # Specify value that is a fraction of the way up the eventual y-axis. This
    # will be used later for positioning annotations containing gene count
    # information for each cluster. 
    # means_range_vector <- 
    #   seq(means_min_floor, means_max_ceiling, length.out = 30)
    # means_scl_lab_y_pos <- means_range_vector[3]
    # means_scl_lab_pct_y_pos <- means_range_vector[27]
    
    # Make cluster columns that are factored to facilitate facet_wrap. Max
    # value is set beyond total number of clusters so that a full grid of
    # facets is generated in every plot, even if they don't all get filled.
    # This makes plot sizes identical across RNA and RBO, which would other-
    # wise differ due to varying number of clusters and, consequently, 
    # varying number of filled rows. 
    Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$clu_facetwrap <-
      factor(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$clu, 
             levels = sort(c(seq(1, 32, by = 1))))
    
    # Construct dataframes to use for annotations.
    text_df <-
      Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df %>%
      select(
        clu,
        clu_gene_ct_Hg,
        clu_gene_ct_HFTV1) %>%
      # Subset to distinct rows only (there are otherwise a lot of redundant
      # rows). 
      distinct(
        clu, 
        # Keep all other columns, not just cluster ID. 
        .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Make a facet_wrap-specific column for text data for the same reasons
    # described above.
    text_df$clu_facetwrap <-
      factor(text_df$clu,
             levels = sort(c(seq(1, 32, by = 1))))
    
    
    # Graph clusters
    
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      plot_height = 40
      plot_width = 80
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      plot_height = 40
      plot_width = 80
    }
    
    # === Np3 ===
  
    Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = rld_means_scl,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
      
      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("Expression level\n(Rlog read ct.s, scaled)") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +
      
      ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +
      
      geom_label(
        data = text_df,
        aes(
          x = 90, 
          y = -2,
            label =
              paste(
                "Hg: ", clu_gene_ct_Hg, " | ",
                "HFTV1: ", clu_gene_ct_HFTV1, sep = "")),
        fontface = "bold",
        label.r = unit(0, "lines"),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        label.size = 0.5,
        size = 4)  +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

        legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border =
          element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

        strip.text.x =
          element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
    
    # Facet (all cluster families in one image)
    
    Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_plot <-
      Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu_facetwrap,
        ncol = 8,
        nrow = 4,
        scales = "free",
        drop = FALSE)
    
    ggsave(
      plot = Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_plot,
        paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_Np3_clu_rld_means_scl.png", sep = ""),
      height = plot_height,
      width = plot_width,
      units = "cm",
      dpi = 300)
    
    # Paginate (cluster families in separate images)

    Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate <-
      Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap_paginate(
        ~ clu,
        ncol = 1,
        nrow = 1,
        scales = "free",
        drop = TRUE)
    
    for (i in 1:n_pages(Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate)) {
      p_save <-
        Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate +
        facet_wrap_paginate(
          ~ clu,
          ncol = 1,
          nrow = 1,
          scales = "free",
          drop = TRUE,
          page = i)

      ggsave(
        plot = p_save,
        filename = paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_", i, ".png", sep = ""),
        height = plot_height*(1/4),
        width = plot_width*(1/8),
        units = "cm")

    }


    Np3_clu_l2fc_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = Np3_clu_l2fc_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = L2FC,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -1.5, linetype = "dashed") +

      annotate("rect", fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25,
        xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
        ymin = -1.5, ymax = 1.5) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +

      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("L2FC read counts \n relative to 0 min PI") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),
```

# === DEA | CLU | VIS | FUN | RNA ===========================================
```{r}
RNA_clu_vis_fun <-
  
  function(
    sample_type,
    AGE_clu_df,
    AGE_rld_means_scl_df,
    AGE_l2fc_df) {
    
    # Convert clusters to factors for graphing to retain cluster hierarchy. 
    AGE_clu_df <- 
      AGE_clu_df %>%
      select(c(clu, gene_id)) %>%
      arrange(clu)
    AGE_clu_df$clu <-
      factor(AGE_clu_df$clu, levels = unique(AGE_clu_df$clu))
    
    # Add entity-specifying column for coloring in graphs.
    AGE_clu_df <-
      AGE_clu_df %>% 
      mutate(
        entity = 
          case_when(
            str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg"))
    
    # Tally number of Hg and HFTV1 genes per cluster for graph annotations
    AGE_clu_df <-
      AGE_clu_df %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(
        clu_gene_ct_Hg = sum(startsWith(gene_id, "HfgLR")),
        clu_gene_ct_HFTV1 = sum(startsWith(gene_id, "M1M17")),
        clu_gene_ct_total = clu_gene_ct_Hg + clu_gene_ct_HFTV1) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    # Combine clusters with RLD means scaled.
    clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_df, AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c("0", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "rld_means_scl")
    clu_means_scl_l_df$time_PI <- 
      as.numeric(clu_means_scl_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Combine clusters with L2FC data
    clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_df, AGE_l2fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c( "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "L2FC")
    clu_l2fc_l_df$time_PI <- as.numeric(clu_l2fc_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Subset for genetic elements
    
    Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42|43", clu))
    Np3_clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42|43", clu))
    
    p3_clu_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42|43", clu))
    p3_clu_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42|43", clu))
    
    # Graph annotation setup for scaled data
    
    # Determine max (rounded up) and min (rounded down) values for expression
    # data. Base on Np3 data since p3 has NAs from 60 min time point absence.
    # means_max_ceiling <- max(ceiling(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$rld_means_scl))
    # means_min_floor <- min(floor(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$rld_means_scl))
    
    # Specify value that is a fraction of the way up the eventual y-axis. This
    # will be used later for positioning annotations containing gene count
    # information for each cluster. 
    # means_range_vector <- 
    #   seq(means_min_floor, means_max_ceiling, length.out = 30)
    # means_scl_lab_y_pos <- means_range_vector[3]
    # means_scl_lab_pct_y_pos <- means_range_vector[27]
    
    # Make cluster columns that are factored to facilitate facet_wrap. Max
    # value is set beyond total number of clusters so that a full grid of
    # facets is generated in every plot, even if they don't all get filled.
    # This makes plot sizes identical across RNA and RBO, which would other-
    # wise differ due to varying number of clusters and, consequently, 
    # varying number of filled rows. 
    Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$clu_facetwrap <-
      factor(Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df$clu, 
             levels = sort(c(seq(1, 32, by = 1))))
    
    # Construct dataframes to use for annotations.
    text_df <-
      Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df %>%
      select(
        clu,
        clu_gene_ct_Hg,
        clu_gene_ct_HFTV1) %>%
      # Subset to distinct rows only (there are otherwise a lot of redundant
      # rows). 
      distinct(
        clu, 
        # Keep all other columns, not just cluster ID. 
        .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Make a facet_wrap-specific column for text data for the same reasons
    # described above.
    text_df$clu_facetwrap <-
      factor(text_df$clu,
             levels = sort(c(seq(1, 32, by = 1))))
    
    
    # Graph clusters
    
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      plot_height = 40
      plot_width = 80
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      plot_height = 40
      plot_width = 80
    }
    
    # === Np3 ===
  
    Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = Np3_clu_means_scl_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = rld_means_scl,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
      
      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("Expression level\n(Rlog read ct.s, scaled)") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +
      
      ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +
      
      geom_label(
        data = text_df,
        aes(
          x = 90, 
          y = -2,
            label =
              paste(
                "Hg: ", clu_gene_ct_Hg, " | ",
                "HFTV1: ", clu_gene_ct_HFTV1, sep = "")),
        fontface = "bold",
        label.r = unit(0, "lines"),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        label.size = 0.5,
        size = 4)  +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

        legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),

        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border =
          element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

        strip.text.x =
          element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
    
    # Facet (all cluster families in one image)
    
    Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_plot <-
      Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu_facetwrap,
        ncol = 8,
        nrow = 4,
        scales = "free",
        drop = FALSE)
    
    ggsave(
      plot = Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_plot,
        paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",

    # Paginate (cluster families in separate images)

        scales = "free",
        drop = TRUE)
    
    for (i in 1:n_pages(Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate)) {

      p3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu,
        ncol = 8,
        nrow = 4,
        scales = "free",
        drop = FALSE)

    ggsave(
      plot = p3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_plot,
        paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_p3_clu_rld_means_scl.png", sep = ""),
      height = plot_height,
      width = plot_width,
      units = "cm",
      dpi = 300)

    # Paginate (cluster families in separate images)

    p3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate <-
      p3_clu_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap_paginate(
        ~ clu,
        ncol = 1,
        nrow = 1,
        scales = "free",
        drop = TRUE)

    for (i in 1:n_pages(p3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate)) {
      p_save <-
        p3_clu_rld_means_scl_facet_paginate +
        facet_wrap_paginate(
          ~ clu,
          ncol = 1,
          nrow = 1,
          scales = "free",
          drop = TRUE,
          page = i)

      ggsave(
        plot = p_save,
        filename = paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_p3_clu_rld_means_scl_", i, ".png", sep = ""),
        height = plot_height*(1/4),
        width = plot_width*(1/8),
        units = "cm")

    }


    p3_clu_l2fc_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = p3_clu_l2fc_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = L2FC,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -1.5, linetype = "dashed") +

      annotate("rect", fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25,
        xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
        ymin = -1.5, ymax = 1.5) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +

      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("L2FC read counts \n relative to 0 min PI") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

        legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border =
          element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

        strip.text.x =
          element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())

    # Facet (all cluster families in one image)

    p3_clu_l2fc_facet_plot <-
      p3_clu_l2fc_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu,
        ncol = 8,
        nrow = 4,
        scales = "free",
        drop = FALSE)

    ggsave(
      plot = p3_clu_l2fc_facet_plot,
        paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_p3_clu_l2fc.png", sep = ""),
      height = plot_height,
      width = plot_width,
      units = "cm",
      dpi = 300)

    # Paginate (cluster families in separate images)

    p3_clu_l2fc_facet_paginate <-
      p3_clu_l2fc_plot +
      facet_wrap_paginate(
        ~ clu,
        ncol = 1,
        nrow = 1,
        scales = "free",
        drop = TRUE)

    for (i in 1:n_pages(p3_clu_l2fc_facet_paginate)) {
      p_save <-
        p3_clu_l2fc_facet_paginate +
        facet_wrap_paginate(
          ~ clu,
          ncol = 1,
          nrow = 1,
          scales = "free",
          drop = TRUE,
          page = i)

      ggsave(
        plot = p_save,
        filename = paste(
          "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/h_CLU/c_VIS/",
          sample_type, "_p3_clu_l2fc_", i, ".png", sep = ""),
        height = plot_height*(1/4),
        width = plot_width*(1/8),
        units = "cm")

    }
    
  }
```

# === DEA | CLU | MEAN AND EXPORT FOR DPGP ==================================
```{r}

# === RBO ===

# Combine RLD and cluster data

RNA_AGE_clu_means_scl_df <-
  left_join(RNA_AGE_clu_df, RNA_AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  select(clu, gene_id, `0`, `5`, `15`, `30`, `60`, `180`) %>%
  # Remove genes with NAs, although this step will not be necessary once
  # I have synchronized DDS genes and DP-GP clustered genes. 
  filter(!is.na(`5`))

RBO_Np3_clu_means_scl_df <-
  left_join(RBO_AGE_clu_df, RBO_AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
  filter(!grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
  select(clu, gene_id, `0`, `5`, `15`, `30`, `60`, `180`) %>%
  # Remove genes with NAs, although this step will not be necessary once
  # I have synchronized DDS genes and DP-GP clustered genes. 
  filter(!is.na(`5`))

# Calculate mean expression trajectory for each cluster
RNA_AGE_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp <-
  RNA_AGE_clu_means_scl_df %>%
  group_by(clu) %>%
  summarize(
    `0` = mean(`0`), 
    `5` = mean(`5`), 
    `15` = mean(`15`),
    `30` = mean(`30`), 
    `60` = mean(`60`), 
    `180` = mean(`180`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clu_names = paste("clu_", clu, sep = "")) %>%
  relocate(clu_names, .before = clu) %>%
  select(!clu)

RBO_Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp <-
  RBO_Np3_clu_means_scl_df %>%
  group_by(clu) %>%
  summarize(
    `0` = mean(`0`), 
    `5` = mean(`5`), 
    `15` = mean(`15`),
    `30` = mean(`30`), 
    `60` = mean(`60`), 
    `180` = mean(`180`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clu_names = paste("clu_", clu, sep = "")) %>%
  relocate(clu_names, .before = clu) %>%
  select(!clu)

# Export to consolidate clusters into families
write.table(
  RNA_AGE_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/a_INPUT/",
    "RNA_AGE_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp.txt", sep = ""),
  sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

write.table(
  RBO_Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/a_INPUT/",
    "RBO_Np3_clu_rld_means_scl_dpgp.txt", sep = ""),
  sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
```

# === DEA | CLU FAM | DPGP IMPORT, p3 INCORPORATION, AND EXPORT =============
```{r}

# Read in cluster family information
RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df <- 
  read.table(
    paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/b_OUTPUT/",
      "RNA_AGE_CFs_scl_optimal_clustering.txt", sep = ""),
    sep = "\t", header = T) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    clu_fam = cluster,
    clu = gene) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove(clu, "clu_"))
RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df$clu <-
  as.numeric(RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df$clu)

RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df <- 
  read.table(
    paste(
      "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/b_OUTPUT/",
      "RBO_Np3_CFs_scl_optimal_clustering.txt", sep = ""),
    sep = "\t", header = T) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    clu_fam = cluster,
    clu = gene) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove(clu, "clu_"))
RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df$clu <-
  as.numeric(RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df$clu)

# Rename cluster families to make them more easily distinguishable from
# gene clusters. Label by approximate size
RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df <-
  RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df %>%
  mutate(
    clu_fam = case_when(
      clu_fam == 1 ~ "D",
      clu_fam == 2 ~ "B",
      clu_fam == 3 ~ "A",
      clu_fam == 4 ~ "C", 
      clu_fam == 5 ~ "F",
      clu_fam == 6 ~ "E"
    )
  )

RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df <-
  RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df %>%
  mutate(
    clu_fam = case_when(
      clu_fam == 1 ~ "B", 
      clu_fam == 2 ~ "D", 
      clu_fam == 3 ~ "A", 
      clu_fam == 4 ~ "C",
      clu_fam == 5 ~ "F",
      clu_fam == 6 ~ "E",
      # Clu fam 7 only has one cluster in it; consolidate.
      clu_fam == 7 ~ "C",
    )
  )

# pHGLR3 genes cannot be clustered with Np3 genes since p3 is missing 60 min PI
# data in RBO dataset. Inspected p3 cluster trajectories manually and compared
# with Np3 family trajectories. 

# By eye, p3 cluster 1 (41) seems pretty similar to Np3 family M-L - general
# upward trend; and p3 cluster 2 (42) seems pretty similar to Np3 family E -
# general downward trend. Combine data accordingly. 

RBO_AGE_clu_fam_df <-
  RBO_Np3_clu_fam_df %>%
  add_row(clu_fam = "B", clu = 41) %>%
  add_row(clu_fam = "A", clu = 42) %>%
  arrange(clu_fam, clu)

# === EXPORT ===

write.csv(
  RNA_AGE_clu_fam_df,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/c_AGE/",
    "RNA_AGE_clu_fam.csv", sep = ""),
  row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  RBO_AGE_clu_fam_df,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/i_CLU_FAM/c_AGE/",
    "RBO_AGE_clu_fam.csv", sep = ""),
  row.names = FALSE)

```

# === DEA | CLU FAM | STATS | CALC AND EXPORT | RNA =========================
```{r}
DE_gene_ct <- nrow(RNA_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df)

RNA_AGE_clu_stats_df <-
  RNA_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>%
  select(c(clu_fam, clu, entity, gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(clu) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    # Number of genes per cluster
    clu_gene_ct = n(),
    # Percent of DE genes per cluster
    DE_gene_pct =
      round((clu_gene_ct/DE_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2),
    # Number of Hg genes per cluster
    clu_Hg_gene_ct = sum(entity == "Hg"),
    # Percent of Hg genes out of all genes in cluster
    clu_genes_Hg_pct = 
      round((clu_Hg_gene_ct/clu_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2),
    # Number of HFTV1 genes per cluster
    clu_HFTV1_gene_ct = sum(entity == "HFTV1"),
    # Percent of HFTV1 genes out of all genes in cluster
    clu_genes_HFTV1_pct = 
      round((clu_HFTV1_gene_ct/clu_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2)) %>%
  ungroup()

RNA_AGE_clu_fam_stats_df <-
  RNA_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>%
  select(c(clu_fam, clu, entity, gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(clu_fam) %>%
  summarize(
    # Number of genes per cluster
    clu_fam_gene_ct = n(),
    # Percent of DE genes per cluster family
    DE_gene_pct =
      round((clu_fam_gene_ct/DE_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2),
    # Number of Hg genes per cluster family
    clu_fam_Hg_gene_ct = sum(entity == "Hg"),
    # Percent of Hg genes out of all genes in cluster
    clu_fam_genes_Hg_pct = 
      round((clu_fam_Hg_gene_ct/clu_fam_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2),
    # Number of HFTV1 genes per cluster
    clu_fam_HFTV1_gene_ct = sum(entity == "HFTV1"),
    # Percent of HFTV1 genes out of all genes in cluster
    clu_fam_genes_HFTV1_pct = 
      round((clu_fam_HFTV1_gene_ct/clu_fam_gene_ct)*100, digits = 2)) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(
  RNA_AGE_clu_stats_df,
```

```{r}
  separate_wider_delim(
    category,
    "_",
    names = c("clu", "fam", "entity", "gene", "ct")
  ) %>%
  select(!c("clu", "fam", "gene", "ct"))
```

# === DEA | CLU FAM | VIS | FUN | RNA ========================================
```{r}
RNA_clu_fam_vis_fun <-
  
  function(
    sample_type,
    AGE_clu_fam_annot_df,
    AGE_rld_means_scl_df,
    AGE_l2fc_df) {
    
    # Convert clusters to factors for graphing to retain cluster hierarchy. 
    AGE_clu_fam_df <- 
      AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>%
      select(c(clu_fam, clu, gene_id)) %>%
      arrange(clu_fam)
    AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam <-
      factor(AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam, levels = unique(AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam))
    
    # Add entity-specifying column for coloring in graphs.
    AGE_clu_fam_df <-
      AGE_clu_fam_df %>% 
      mutate(
        entity = 
          case_when(
            str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg"))
    
    # Combine clusters with RLD means scaled.
    clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_fam_df, AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c("0", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "rld_means_scl")
    clu_fam_means_scl_l_df$time_PI <- 
      as.numeric(clu_fam_means_scl_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Combine clusters with L2FC data
    clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_fam_df, AGE_l2fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c( "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "L2FC")
    clu_fam_l2fc_l_df$time_PI <- as.numeric(clu_fam_l2fc_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Subset for genetic elements
    
    Np3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_fam_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    Np3_clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_fam_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    
    p3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_fam_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    p3_clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_fam_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    
    
    # Graph clusters
    
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      plot_height = 10
      plot_width = 58
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      plot_height = 10
      plot_width = 58
    }
    
    # === Np3 ===
  
    Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = Np3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = rld_means_scl,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
      
      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("Expression level\n(Rlog read ct.s, scaled)") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +
      
      ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

        legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border =
          element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

        strip.text.x =
          element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
    
    # Facet (all cluster families in one image)
    
    Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_facet_plot <-
      Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu_fam,
        ncol = 8,

    ggsave(
```

```{r}
  function(
```
