```{r}
      arrange(clu_fam)
    AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam <-
      factor(AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam, levels = unique(AGE_clu_fam_df$clu_fam))
    
    # Add entity-specifying column for coloring in graphs.
    AGE_clu_fam_df <-
      AGE_clu_fam_df %>% 
      mutate(
        entity = 
          case_when(
            str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg"))
    
    # Combine clusters with RLD means scaled.
    clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_fam_df, AGE_rld_means_scl_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c("0", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "rld_means_scl")
    clu_fam_means_scl_l_df$time_PI <- 
      as.numeric(clu_fam_means_scl_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Combine clusters with L2FC data
    clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      left_join(AGE_clu_fam_df, AGE_l2fc_df, by = "gene_id") %>%
      # Remove NA values (20251024 - this is only required due to discrepancy
      # between DPGP-clustered genes my new threshold for smallestCountSize 
      # for my DDS; NA removal should not be necessary once DPGP has been
      # rerun in my upcoming analyses to incorporate 200 min PI samples).
      filter(!is.na(`5`)) %>%
      # Pivot data for graphing
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c( "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"),
        names_to = "time_PI", values_to = "L2FC")
    clu_fam_l2fc_l_df$time_PI <- as.numeric(clu_fam_l2fc_l_df$time_PI)
    
    # Subset for genetic elements
    
    Np3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_fam_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    Np3_clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_fam_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to Np3
      filter(!grepl("41|42", clu))
    
    p3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df <-
      clu_fam_means_scl_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    p3_clu_fam_l2fc_l_df <-
      clu_fam_l2fc_l_df %>% 
      # Subset to p3
      filter(grepl("41|42", clu)) %>%
      # Remove 060 TP
      filter(!time_PI == "60")
    
    
    # Graph clusters
    
    if (sample_type == "RBO") {
      plot_height = 10
      plot_width = 58
    } else if (sample_type == "RNA") {
      plot_height = 10
      plot_width = 58
    }
    
    # === Np3 ===
  
    Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_plot <-
      ggplot(
        data = Np3_clu_fam_means_scl_l_df,
        aes(
          x = time_PI,
          y = rld_means_scl,
          group = gene_id,
          color = entity,
          shape = entity)) +

      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
      
      xlab("Time post-infection (minutes)") +
      ylab("Expression level\n(Rlog read ct.s, scaled)") +

      scale_color_manual(values = c(HFTV1="red", Hg="black")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(HFTV1=5, Hg=1)) +
      
      ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +

      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

        axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

        legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
        # No legend
        legend.position="none",

        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.border =
          element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),
        rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),

        strip.text.x =
          element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
    
    # Facet (all cluster families in one image)
    
    Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_facet_plot <-
      Np3_clu_fam_rld_means_scl_plot +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ clu_fam,
        ncol = 8,
        nrow = 4,
        scales = "free",
        drop = FALSE)
    
    ggsave(
```

# === DEA | FNC | COG | LVL1 | CTS ===========================================
```{r}
# Count number of times each COG lvl1 category appears

# === REFERENCES ===

# Hg
Hg_cog_lvl1_df <-
  Hg_HFTV1_annot_CDS_df %>%
  # Select Hg genetic elements
  filter(!seqnames == "NC_062739.1") %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Assign an ID for comparison of ORA across different groups (Hg/HFTV1,
  # DEG/NDEG, cluster families, etc.)
  mutate(ORA_group = "Hg") %>%
  relocate(ORA_group, .before = COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n)

# HFTV1
HFTV1_cog_lvl1_df <-
  Hg_HFTV1_annot_CDS_df %>%
  # Select HFTV1 genome
  filter(seqnames == "NC_062739.1") %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ORA_group = "HFTV1") %>%
  relocate(ORA_group, .before = COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n)

# Merged reference
Hg_HFTV1_cog_lvl1_df <-
  Hg_HFTV1_annot_CDS_df %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ORA_group = "Hg_HFTV1") %>%
  relocate(ORA_group, .before = COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n)

# === RBO DEG/NDEG ===

# Convert COG columns to factors
RBO_AGE_DEG_NDEG_rld_means_annot_df <- 
  COG_factor_conversion_fun(RBO_AGE_DEG_NDEG_rld_means_annot_df)

# ∆Ribo DEG
RBO_DEG_cog_lvl1_df <-
  RBO_AGE_DEG_NDEG_rld_means_annot_df %>%
  filter(RBO_DE == "DEG") %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ORA_group = "RBO_DEG") %>%
  relocate(ORA_group, .before = COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n)

# ∆Ribo NDEG
RBO_NDEG_cog_lvl1_df <-
  RBO_AGE_DEG_NDEG_rld_means_annot_df %>%
  filter(RBO_DE == "NDEG") %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ORA_group = "RBO_NDEG") %>%
  relocate(ORA_group, .before = COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n)

# === CLUSTER FAMILIES ===

RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df <- 
  COG_factor_conversion_fun(RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df)

RBO_clu_fam_cog_lvl1_df <-
  RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>%
  group_by(clu_fam) %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ORA_group = clu_fam)

# === COMPILE DATA ===

RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_df <-
  do.call(
    "rbind", 
    list(
      Hg_HFTV1_cog_lvl1_df,
      Hg_cog_lvl1_df,
      HFTV1_cog_lvl1_df,
      RBO_DEG_cog_lvl1_df,
      RBO_NDEG_cog_lvl1_df,
      RBO_clu_fam_cog_lvl1_df))

COG_code_lvl1_df <- 
  COG_code_df %>%
  select(c(COG_desc_lvl1, COG_desc_lvl1_long)) %>%
```

```{r}
RBO_clu_fam_cog_lvl1_Hg_df <-
  RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>%
  filter(entity == "Hg") %>%
  group_by(clu_fam) %>%
  dplyr::count(COG_desc_lvl1, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_ct = n) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ORA_group = clu_fam)

# === COMPILE DATA ===

COG_code_lvl1_df <- 
  COG_code_df %>%
  select(c(COG_desc_lvl1, COG_desc_lvl1_long)) %>%
  distinct()

RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_Hg_df <-
  left_join(
    RBO_clu_fam_cog_lvl1_Hg_df, 
    COG_code_lvl1_df,
    by = "COG_desc_lvl1") %>%
  filter(COG_desc_lvl1 != "NAN") %>%
  filter(COG_desc_lvl1 != "viral") %>%
  filter(COG_desc_lvl1 != "integrated_viral_elements")

RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_bar <-
  ggplot(
    data = RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_Hg_df,
    aes(
      x = COG_desc_lvl1_long, 
      y = gene_ct, 
      group = ORA_group,
      fill = COG_desc_lvl1)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      information_storage_and_processing = "indianred3",
      cellular_processes_and_signaling = "royalblue2",
      metabolism = "chartreuse3",
      poorly_characterized = "grey20")) +
  ylab("Number of genes") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
      plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

      axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),
      # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),
      legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'),
      legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
      # No legend
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
      panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80")
      ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ ORA_group,
    ncol = 6,
    nrow = 2,
    scales = "free_x")

ggsave(
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/j_FNC/b_COG_LVL1_CTS/",
  "RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_bar_Hg_only.png"),
  RBO_cog_lvl1_cts_bar,
  width = 50, 
  height = 7,
  units = "cm")
```

```{r}
  dplyr::count(COG_category, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  summarize(
    ORA_group_size = sum(gene_ct))

# Introduce ORA group sizes to category fraction info
```

# === DEA | FNC | COG | LVL2 | ORA | CALC ====================================
```{r}

RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df <-
  RBO_cog_lvl2_frc_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate expected number of genes per category based on ORA group size
    # and percent of genes assigned to each category in Hg-HFTV1 merged
    # reference.
    expected_gene_ct = ORA_group_size*ref_category_frc,
    
    # Calculate fold over-representation
    fold_or = gene_ct/expected_gene_ct,
    
    # Log-transformed fold over-representation, with constant added to prevent
    # issues with undefied values
    l2_fold_or = log2(fold_or + 0.1)
    )

write.csv(
  RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/j_FNC/f_COG_LVL2_ORA/",
    "RBO_cog_lvl2_ora.csv", sep = ""),
  row.names = FALSE)

```

# === DEA | FNC | COG | LVL2 | ORA | SIGNIF ==================================
```{r}

RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df <-
  data.frame(
    ORA_group = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df$ORA_group,
    COG_category = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df$COG_category,
    # x: Number of successes, or number of genes that appeared for a given
    # category within an ORA group. 
    x = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df$gene_ct,
    # n: Number of trials, or number of genes within an ORA group. 
    n = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df$ORA_group_size,
    # p: Probability of success, or fraction of a given category in the merged
    # reference dataset. 
    p = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df$ref_category_frc)

# Subset to cluster families
RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df <-
  RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df %>%
  filter(grepl("A|B|C|D|E|F", ORA_group))

RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df$binom_p_value <-
  apply(
    X = RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df,
    # margin: 1 applies function over rows; 2 applies function over columns
    MARGIN = 1,
    # fun: Function to apply across dataframe
    FUN = function(input_df) {
      # Perform binomial test on each row
      binom_test_res <-
        binom.test(
          # Must refer to columns by index number, not by name (i.e., "$...")
          x = as.numeric(input_df[3]),
          n = as.numeric(input_df[4]),
          p = as.numeric(input_df[5]),
          # Two-sided test to be more conservative
          alternative = c("two.sided"),
          # With "$p.value", specify apply output to be p-value (there is
          # other information stored in binom test results).
          conf.level = 0.95)$p.value
      }
  )

# FDR correction
RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df$binom_p_val_fdr <-
  p.adjust(
    RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df$binom_p_val,
    method = "BH")

# Export
write_csv(
  RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df,
  paste(
    "../c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/a_ISO/j_FNC/g_COG_LVL2_ORA_SIGNIF/",
    "RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom.csv", sep = ""))

```

```{r}
RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_vis_df <- 
  left_join(
    RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_df,
    RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df %>% select(!c(x, n, p)),
    by = c("ORA_group", "COG_category"))

RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_vis_df <-
  RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_vis_df %>%
  mutate(
    binom_p_val_fdr_vis = 
      ifelse(
        binom_p_val_fdr < 0.05, "*", NA)) %>%
  mutate(
    binom_p_val_vis = 
      ifelse(
        (binom_p_value < 0.05 & binom_p_val_fdr > 0.05), "*", NA))
```

# === TEA | WRANGLE AND TE CALCULATE (*) =====================================
```{r}
# RNA
RNA_AGE_sfn_means_long_df <-
  RNA_AGE_sfn_means_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !gene_id,
    names_to = "time_PI",
    values_to = "RNA_sfn")

# RBO
RBO_AGE_sfn_means_long_df <-
  RBO_AGE_sfn_means_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = !gene_id,
    names_to = "time_PI",
    values_to = "RBO_sfn")

# Combine RNA and RBO
TE_df <-
  inner_join(
    RNA_AGE_sfn_means_long_df %>%
      select(gene_id, time_PI, RNA_sfn),
    RBO_AGE_sfn_means_long_df %>%
      select(gene_id, time_PI, RBO_sfn),
    by = c("gene_id", "time_PI")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Add entity information
    entity = 
      case_when(
        str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1", TRUE ~ "Hg"),
    # Pseudocounts prior to TE calculation
    RNA_sfn = RNA_sfn + 1,
    RBO_sfn = RBO_sfn + 1,
    # Calculate TE
    TE = RBO_sfn/RNA_sfn,
    RNA_sfn_log10 = log10(RNA_sfn),
    RBO_sfn_log10 = log10(RBO_sfn),
    TE_log2 = log2(TE)) 

TE_df$time_PI <- 
  as.numeric(TE_df$time_PI)

# Add CF information
TE_df <-
  inner_join(
    TE_df,
    RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df %>% 
      select(
        c(
          clu_fam, 
          gene_id,
          product,
          COG_desc_lvl1,
          COG_desc_lvl1_long,
          COG_category,
          COG_desc_lvl2,
          COG_desc_lvl2_long,
          Description,
          eggNOG_gene_name)),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) %>%
  relocate(clu_fam, .before = "gene_id") %>%
  relocate(entity, .after = "gene_id")

```

```{r}
TE_long_df <-
  TE_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(RNA_sfn, RBO_sfn, TE, RNA_sfn_log10, RBO_sfn_log10, TE_log2),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "expr_value") %>%
  # Remove rows of p3 genes with NA values
  filter(!is.na(expr_value))

TE_long_plot_df <- TE_long_df

TE_long_plot_df$time_PI <-
  factor(
    TE_long_plot_df$time_PI,
    levels = c("0", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180"))

TE_long_plot_df$entity <-
  factor(
    TE_long_plot_df$entity,
    levels = c("Hg", "HFTV1")
  )
```

# === TEA | DISTRIBUTIONS | VIS | Hg =========================================
```{r}
TE_plot <-
  ggplot(
    TE_long_plot_df %>%
      filter(entity == "Hg") %>%
      filter(category == "TE"),
    aes(
      x = entity,
      y = expr_value,
      color = entity,
      fill = entity,
      shape = entity)) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 4) +
  
  geom_violin(
    lwd=1, 
    scale = "width", 
    width = 0.8,
    # color = "black",
    # aes(fill = entity),
    alpha = 0.25 
    ) + 
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 10, 
    linetype = "dashed",
    lwd = 1) +
  
  # 
  # geom_point(
  #   stat="weighted_mean",
  #   shape = "-",
  #   size = 10,
  #   aes(
  #     color = entity)) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Hg = "grey30",
      HFTV1 = "red")) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      Hg = "black",
      HFTV1 = "red")) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      HFTV1 = 23,
      Hg = 21)) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ time_PI,
    scales = "fixed",
    nrow = 1,
    ncol = 6
  ) +
  
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(r=10)),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

    axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

    legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
    # No legend
    legend.position="none",

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border =
      element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.75),
    panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

    strip.text.x =
      element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80"))

ggsave(
  paste(
    "/Users/mi/DIRUGGIERO_LAB/PROJECTS_AND_RESULTS/H_GIBBONSII_HFTV1/",
    "RNA_RBO/c_ANA/c_DE_ANALYSIS/b_TEA/a_ABSOLUTE/b_DISTRIBUTIONS/",
    "TE_Hg_time_violin.png", 
    sep = ""),
  plot = TE_plot,
  width = 50,
  height = 20,
  units = "cm", 
  dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Wrangle ORA binomial test results to combine with other data
RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_tojoin_df <-
  RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_df %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    COG_ora_raw_p_val = binom_p_value,
    COG_ora_fdr_p_val = binom_p_val_fdr,
    clu_fam = ORA_group) %>%
  select(c(clu_fam, COG_category, COG_ora_raw_p_val, COG_ora_fdr_p_val))

# Combine annotation and ORA data
master_df <-
  left_join(
    RBO_AGE_clu_fam_annot_df,
    RBO_cog_lvl2_ora_binom_tojoin_df,
    by = c("clu_fam", "COG_category")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_000 = `0`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_005 = `5`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_015 = `15`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_030 = `30`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_060 = `60`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rld_180 = `180`)

# Combine annotation/ORA and L2FC data
master_df <-
  left_join(
    master_df %>%
      select(!c(COG_desc_lvl1_long, COG_desc_lvl2_long)),
    RBO_AGE_wald_l2fc_df %>%
      select(c("gene_id", "5", "15", "30", "60", "180")),
    by = "gene_id")

# Reorganize and rename columns for convenience
master_df <-
  master_df %>%
  relocate(eggNOG_gene_name, .after = gene_id) %>%
  relocate(Description, .after = `180`) %>%
  relocate(COG_category, .after = COG_desc_lvl2) %>%
  relocate(gene_id, .after = seqnames) %>%
  relocate(protein_id, .after = type) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    L2FC_005_v_000 = `5`,
    L2FC_015_v_000 = `15`,
    L2FC_030_v_000 = `30`,
    L2FC_060_v_000 = `60`,
    L2FC_180_v_000 = `180`) %>%
  arrange(clu_fam, seqnames, start)

# Add sfn data
master_df <-
  left_join(
    master_df,
    RBO_AGE_sfn_means_df %>%
      select(c(gene_id, `0`, `5`, `15`, `30`, `60`, `180`)),
    by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sfn_000 = `0`,
    sfn_005 = `5`,
    sfn_015 = `15`,
    sfn_030 = `30`,
    sfn_060 = `60`,
    sfn_180 = `180`)

# Add TE data
master_df <-
  left_join(
    master_df,
    TE_w_df,
    by = "gene_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    TE_000 = `0`,
    TE_005 = `5`,
    TE_015 = `15`,
    TE_030 = `30`,
    TE_060 = `60`,
    TE_180 = `180`)

# Rearrange more columns for convenience
master_df <-
  master_df %>%
  select(
    !c(
      start, end, width, type, COG_ora_raw_p_val)) %>%
  relocate(TE_180) %>%
  relocate(TE_060) %>%
  relocate(TE_030) %>%
  relocate(TE_015) %>%
  relocate(TE_005) %>%
  relocate(TE_000) %>%
  relocate(L2FC_180_v_000) %>%
  relocate(L2FC_060_v_000) %>%
  relocate(L2FC_030_v_000) %>%
  relocate(L2FC_015_v_000) %>%
  relocate(L2FC_005_v_000) %>%
  relocate(rld_180) %>%
  relocate(rld_060) %>%
  relocate(rld_030) %>%
  relocate(rld_015) %>%
  relocate(rld_005) %>%
  relocate(rld_000) %>%
  relocate(sfn_180) %>%
  relocate(sfn_060) %>%
  relocate(sfn_030) %>%
  relocate(sfn_015) %>%
  relocate(sfn_005) %>%
  relocate(sfn_000) %>%
  relocate(padj_bh) %>%
  relocate(baseMean) %>%
  relocate(COG_ora_fdr_p_val) %>%
  relocate(COG_category) %>%
  relocate(COG_desc_lvl2) %>%
  relocate(COG_desc_lvl1) %>%
  relocate(Description) %>%
  relocate(product) %>%
  relocate(eggNOG_gene_name) %>%
  relocate(strand) %>%
  relocate(source) %>%
  relocate(protein_id) %>%
  relocate(gene_id) %>%
  relocate(seqnames) %>%
  relocate(entity) %>%
  relocate(clu) %>%
  relocate(clu_fam) %>%
  relocate(RBO_DE)

# Individual CFs
# Split annotated cluster data by consolidated cluster
master_split <-
  split(
    master_df,
    master_df$clu_fam)

# Export annotation information for each cluster individually
for (i in master_split) {

  # Assign cluster ID to a variable to help with exporting process

}

# All CFs combined

  master_df,
```

# === DEA | 200 V 150 | INPUTS ===============================================
```{r}
# Prepare data and metadata for DE analysis
# Some code is derived from SRC

RBO_fc_fn <- function(rep, sample) {
  
  dataframe <- 
    # Read in featurecounts data
    read_tsv(paste("../b_REP/", rep,
                   "_RBO/e_SEQ_ANALYSIS/m_FEATURECOUNTS/", sample,
                   "_fc.txt", sep=""),
             # Skip first line (record of featurecounts command)
             skip=1, 
             # Do not show column type
             show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    # Rename columns 
    dplyr::rename(
      # Column 1: gene ID
      gene_id = 1,
      # Column 7: sample-specific feature counts
      {{sample}}:=7) %>%
    # Select only the gene_id and read counts columns for further use. 
    dplyr::select(c(1,7)) %>% 
    # Round read count values to nearest integer (for featurecount data
    # generated using --fraction option for reads that map to overlapping
    # features. 
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 0)) %>%
    # Subset to unique entries
    unique()
  
  return(dataframe)
  
}
```

# === DEA | 200 V 150 | DDS ==================================================
```{r}
dds_generate_filter_fn <- function(count_data, col_data) {
  
  # Construct DESeqDataSet (DDS)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = count_data,
    colData = col_data,
    design = ~ time)
  # batch cannot be incorporated into experimental design when 200 min 
  # PI samples are included. 
    # design = ~ batch + time)
  
  # Define values for pre-filtering. 
  
  # smallestCountSize: Minimum number of counts per gene
  smallestCountSize <- 50
  # smallestGroupSize: Minimum number of groups in which gene is expressed.
  # If there are not discrete groups, use the minimal number of samples where
  # non-zero counts would be considered interesting. 
  smallestGroupSize <- 2
  
  # Filter DDS
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= smallestCountSize) >=
    smallestGroupSize
  dds_filter <- dds[keep,]
  
  return(dds_filter)
}

RBO_Np3_dds <- 
  dds_generate_filter_fn(RBO_fc_Np3_df, RBO_Np3_meta_df)
RBO_Np3_dds_vals <- assay(RBO_Np3_dds)


```

```{r}
wald_reform_fn <- function(input_data) {
  df <- input_data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    mutate(logpadj = -log10(padj),
           Group = case_when(str_detect(gene_id, "M1M17") ~ "HFTV1",
                            TRUE ~ "Hg"))
  
  return(df)
}

RBO_Np3_wald_res_200E_vs_150E_df <-
  wald_reform_fn(RBO_Np3_wald_res_200E_vs_150E)

write_csv(
```

```{r}
test_plot <-

      filter(entity == "Hg"),
    aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = logpadj)) +
  geom_point(stroke=0.75, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1.5, 1.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  
  xlim(-6, 6) +
  ylim(0, 60) +
  
  xlab("L2FC, 200 vs. 150 min PI") +
  ylab("log10(Adjusted p-value)") +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title=element_text(size=18, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=10)),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", color="black"),

    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.75, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length=unit(0.25, "cm"),

    axis.line=element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),

    legend.text = element_text(face="bold", size=12),

    legend.position="none",

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border =

    panel.spacing = unit(3, "lines"),

    strip.text.x =
      element_text(margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0), size = 14, face="bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80")
    )

ggsave(

)
```
